description: OpenQuake engine QA test 'scenario/case_1': one simple-fault rupture (Mw 6.5, vertical, hypocentre 0/0/6 km), three sites along 0 E, PGA with BooreAtkinson2008, truncation 1.0, maximum_distance 5 km, 102 ground-motion fields. The expected file is the engine's own gmf_data export for ses_seed=3 as shipped in the repository (branch engine-3.26). Copied verbatim; not edited. rupture's ScenarioGroundMotionJob writes random_seed, not ses_seed, so the sampled values are not reproducible from this file; it is kept as the reference distribution the run is compared against, never as an exact target.
